responsibilities: Extend the AssetLoader to support loading and binding FragmentShader files using Flutter's standard asset-loading system (`FragmentProgram.fromAsset`) on both Native (IO) and Web targets.
Implement ShaderMaterial components storing shader program references and preallocated Float32List parameters.
Integrate FragmentShader binding into the Sprite and Tilemap batch render systems.
constraints: Must strictly adhere to zero per-frame allocation rules.
Do not implement custom HTTP or Base64 loading logic for shaders; utilize Flutter's standard asset system (`FragmentProgram.fromAsset`), which is natively cross-platform.
Uniform float updates and shader binds must not allocate heap objects during frame draw calls.
context: Focuses on enabling shaders, post-processing materials, uniform updates, and custom graphic pipelines within the engine.
